text:
maya: running the new synthetic residency sweep on kvcache and seeing odd tail growth on long-context interleaves. attaching quick notes.
arpit: can you paste the harness cmd you used? trying to reproduce locally.
maya: sure — `./bench/kvcache_sweep --workload=interleaved_long --duration=20m --kv-pages=4G --seed=42`
maya: interesting thing: when we enable slab-scan compaction the free slab count drops but resident set doesn't shrink. looks like fragmentation, not a leak.
lena: do we have flame samples for the compaction path? I want to see if threads are stuck in mmap/munmap or memcpy.
maya: yes, i ran `perf record -F 99 -g -- ./bench/...` and perf-bot posted the flame link: https://perf.redwood/test/198765
perf-bot: perf run complete: https://perf.redwood/test/198765 (stack samples + aggregated trace)
sam: I looked at the flame — a lot of samples in `kv::reuse::scatter_slab` and `malloc_trim` on the same timeframe.
arpit: scatter_slab is the new fast path for partial reuse, maybe it's producing lots of tiny free extents that bloat fragmentation.
lena: can we add a variant that forces larger eviction granularity to test? e.g. `--evict-grain=64k` vs `4k` and compare.
maya: did that. 64k reduces fragmentation but increases per-evict latency. latency SLOs are tight for small requests.
ops-bot: ci/regtest: kvcache-residency-sweep failed on commit a1b2c3 — growth > 200MB after 10m.
arpit: which CI job? I saw a flaky in `kvcache-long-context-suite` yesterday but wasn't sure it's the same.
maya: different harness, this one is synthetic interleaved. logs: ```
[2026-03-01 12:02:03] kv: evicted 128 extents, freed 512KB
[2026-03-01 12:02:48] kv: compacted slab id=7 removed 3 extents
[2026-03-01 12:05:12] kv: resident=3.2GB rss=3.5GB cached=1.1GB
``` 
sam: that resident vs cached delta is the red flag — page scattering in user heap or OS-level fragmentation.
lena: experiment idea: enable mmap-backed slabs with MADV_DONTNEED on released pages and compare. If RSS drops then it's OS fragmentation we can tackle with MADV.
arpit: good: add two regression test variants to CI: `residency-madv` and `residency-compact-grain`. They'll run 15m each on nightly dedicated runners.
maya: also adding a shorter presubmit smoke: 3m interleaved with a seed to catch regressions fast.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1429 to coordinate CI jobs + dashboard. Assigned to @arpit and @maya.
arpit: I'll push the harness patch with flags and a quick perf profile capture. PR will include a small parser to extract `resident` and `rss` samples into our telemetry format.
maya: for the regression baseline we should record max-resident-per-minute and 95th percentile of slab fragmentation ratio. I'll add to the perf-bot output.
perf-bot: new metric keys: `kvcache.rss.max`, `kvcache.fragmentation.p95`, `kvcache.evict.rate` — will appear in nightly dashboards.
sam: one more note — when running with quantized models the token-density changes and we saw different eviction rhythms. include model-token density as an input dimension in the benchmark.
lena: agreed. let's keep the synthetic workload parameterized: token_density, interleave_factor, evict_grain.
arpit: ok i'll open the PR tonight and link here. rough timeline: land harness change + CI job within 2 days, gather 3 nights of runs, then decide if we need to change compaction heuristics.
maya: thanks all. if anyone hits the ci failure ping me and i'll triage live.
sam: thanks — will follow up with a small scatter-repro script.
arpit: @maya adding the short smoke to presubmit now. :thumbsup:
